limitations: Source frame arithmetic and emission counts are not Flash execution, collision measurements, or empirical probabilities.
Contact profiles are deliberate scenarios. The working profile has not been measured in player feedback.
The ranged AI pool is only the 220-500 distance branch. Equal sampling is conditional, not the whole AI's action frequency.
Ray peaks, ammo capacity, direct damage, blood skill, and shield conversion are proposals, never loaded into production.
Solo fire assumes full online fire control unless an explicit online fraction is selected; no allies/pets are included.
Infinite reserve clips are an inventory assumption, not free ammunition. Potion scenarios are explicit external inputs.
